# View Content Graph

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Displays a content graph of variable.

## Syntax

~~~~text
contentGraph(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
contentGraph(input: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
